name: radare2
notes: Homebrew's Apple Silicon bottle (formula radare2 6.2.4, /opt/homebrew/opt/radare2); bin/ holds links to its programs, so `brew upgrade radare2` updates it. The earlier local build is kept aside in bin.local-build/. test.sh passed on 2026-10-16 with the Homebrew build (9 checks: rasm2 MIPS/Thumb/PPC/SM83 disassembly, rasm2 MIPS and ARM assembly, radare2 ESIL emulation, and aaa/pdf on a self-built Thumb object when arm-none-eabi-gcc is present). sha256 is null: Homebrew checks its own bottle.
